name: worktree-guidelines
description: Guidelines-first worktree workflow. On entering a git worktree you run the `worktree-manager` skill and act as the manager: interview the user, split tasks, run parallel `worktree-coder`s, then `worktree-type-checker` and `worktree-reviewer` looping until the review passes. Each coder loads a per-language `<lang>-guidelines` skill (built via `guideline-builder` if none exists yet) and uses Context7 for up-to-date library docs. Use for any isolated feature work in a worktree.
